blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The municipal government of Santa Lucia in this province recently launched the Paleng-QR PH Plus program to promote cashless transactions among market vendors, transport operators, small businesses and consumers. The initiative, spearheaded by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) in partnership with the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) on Oct. 15, aims to expand access to digital payment services, particularly in public markets and local transportation. According to the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) in Ilocos Sur, the program would help micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) adopt digital payment systems, making […]...
